additive: This layer is separate from benchmark/. No source benchmark file, split, answer key or score is modified by this script.

answer_key.ci_verification: --check verifies the manifest and both task files without reading the key. If the key file is absent (fresh checkout or CI) its contents are reported as local-only and unverified, not treated as missing evidence
answer_key.implication: the key is not a secret: the split is deterministic and the same key is reproducible from public committed sources at the recorded seed. What varies is git tracking: it is not tracked by git. This layer must never be described as a private or protected evaluation; the only genuinely private evaluation in this repository is the VLUN-Prove private split, whose key lives outside the tracked tree.
answer_key.key_status_meaning: OPEN_KEY means the key provides no confidentiality: the split is deterministic and the key is regenerable from the committed benchmark files at the recorded seed. It does NOT mean the key file is tracked or published in this repository
answer_key.publish_note: the key file is not tracked by git; it is reproducible from the committed benchmark files at the recorded seed
answer_key.retrievable_by: anyone who can run scripts/build_secondary_holdout.py against the committed benchmark files; it is not a secret

clean_holdout.claim: every row in this file has ZERO known literal-answer overlap. This is the only partition in this layer claimed leakage-free
clean_holdout.verification: recomputed from the written payload and the committed benchmark families by scripts/build_secondary_holdout.py --check, without reading the answer key; a row is leaking when evidence_text() contains the gold scalar as a word-boundary literal

exploratory_holdout.claim: these rows are EXPLORATORY. Their model-facing payload carries the answer literal because the source family's evidence names it. They are not independent, not leakage-free and must not be reported as holdout evidence

independence_guarantee: The clean partition is built only from the committed benchmark files. No model, prompt or threshold was tuned against it, and it did not exist while any published score was produced. This guarantee applies to rows in secondary_holdout_tasks.jsonl only; the exploratory file is not independent evidence.
method: group_disjoint: whole groups partitioned with a seeded shuffle, stratified by each group's label set. class_disjoint: all rows of the two rarest labels held out, then every group touching a held-out row removed from the retained side, so retained labels and retained groups are both disjoint from the holdout. Held-out rows whose payload contains the gold scalar are then either redacted (only where the literal sits in non-essential provenance text) or excluded from the clean partition.

model_facing_tasks.exploratory_note: rows in the exploratory file still carry their answer in the payload because the source family's evidence names it. They are labelled exploratory and must never be counted as clean, independent or leakage-free holdout results
model_facing_tasks.task_id: a digest of (family, holdout, original id): stable, joinable to the key file, and it names nothing the answer depends on

payload_answer_literal_overlap.claim: the clean holdout contains zero rows with a known literal-answer overlap. Contaminated rows remain only in the exploratory file (K_language_ecosystem_routing.jsonl: 20, L_severity_reconciliation.jsonl: 9) and are not clean, independent or leakage-free
payload_answer_literal_overlap.definition: word-boundary literal occurrence of the gold scalar in evidence_text(input), the audit's model-facing evidence: instruction scaffolding (prompt, class_vocabulary, taxonomy, tier_rules, prompt_to_answer) and nested prompt/question keys are excluded because they describe the label space to every row

families_excluded_from_clean.K_language_ecosystem_routing.jsonl: the gold is the language name and the model-facing evidence IS that name: repository slugs (OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts), file extensions (*.cairo, *.move), component names and prose ('Cairo VM', 'Move bytecode verifier'). Redacting every literal occurrence truncates the routing evidence itself, and the remaining ecosystem names (Sui/Aptos/Starknet) still determine the language. 20 of the 23 held-out rows leak; the family is therefore reported as exploratory, not repaired by cosmetic redaction

families_transformed_for_clean.O_record_class_and_scope.jsonl: the record-class word occurs only in a source title or URL slug ('... DoS vulnerability needs to be applied', '... Incident Report ...'); the scope evidence (components, prose, other sources) is untouched, so the literal can be redacted without weakening the task
